sources.finding: Lookup checks process.env, environment-specific local file, generic local except test, environment file, then generic env; first value wins. The test-specific local file is loaded.
Published MCP server updates and packaged skill updates are different: skill/metadata changes require a new publisher ZIP.
Local marketplace source refresh and desktop restart instructions concern local authored packages; they do not establish an end-user curated remote cache editing/update route.
Maintained docs name the Vercel upstream plugin and per-client installation; its OpenCode update command is not a Codex remote-package update command.

contradiction.evidence: Both current upstream and installed section wrongly say environment-specific local file is skipped in test; latest Next docs contradict this.
